meta.description: GDPR information, data processing details, and user rights on Sublynk.

commitment.title: Our commitment to GDPR
commitment.body: Sublynk is fully committed to GDPR compliance. As a France-based business, we have designed our platform with Privacy by Design and data protection as core principles.

dataCollected.title: Personal data collected
dataCollected.body: We only collect personal data that is strictly necessary to operate the service:

account.title: Account data
account.items: Email, first name, last name, password (hashed with bcrypt), creation date

organization.title: Organization data
organization.items: Organization name, slug, billing email, time zone

customer.title: Customer data (your subscribers)
customer.items: Telegram username (required), Telegram identifier (if available), display name (optional), email (optional — only if you provide it during checkout)

telegram.title: Telegram-related data
telegram.items: Technical identifiers (Telegram user_id, chat_id/channel_id) required to manage access. We do not collect or store Telegram message content.

payment.title: Payment data
payment.items: Stripe transaction identifiers, amounts, statuses (we do NOT store card numbers)

stripe.title: Data collected by Stripe during payment
stripe.items: Email and billing details collected directly by Stripe to process payment. We only receive/store your email on Sublynk’s side if you enter it in our form.

technical.title: Technical data
technical.items: IP address (server logs), browser type, pages visited, timestamps

support.title: Support data
support.items: Email exchanges and any information you choose to share with us when requesting assistance

cookies.title: Cookies and trackers
cookies.body: We use cookies that are strictly necessary for the service to function, as well as audience measurement trackers (Google Analytics via Google Tag Manager) only after your consent, when required.

session.label: Authentication / session cookie(s)
session.text: User authentication and session persistence – Duration: session / up to 7 days

locale.label: Language preference cookie (NEXT_LOCALE)
locale.text: Stores your selected language – Duration: 1 year

analytics.label: Audience measurement (Google Analytics via Google Tag Manager)
analytics.text: Traffic statistics and service improvement – Legal basis: consent – Duration: based on GA4 configuration

cmp.label: Consent management (consentmanager.net)
cmp.text: Cookie banner and storage of your consent choices – Legal basis: legal obligation/consent depending on trackers – Duration: based on consentmanager.net configuration

cookies.noTracking: No advertising tracking is activated without your consent.
cookies.consent: You can accept or refuse audience measurement at any time via our consent banner (or cookie settings). Refusing does not prevent you from using the service.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis for processing
legalBasis.body: We process personal data on the following legal bases:

contract.label: Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)):
contract.text: Account management, payment processing, Telegram channel access management, sending invitation links, and transactional notifications (Telegram; email only if provided)

legitimate.label: Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)):
legitimate.text: Service improvement, fraud prevention, security, technical logs and debugging

legal.label: Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)):
legal.text: Retention of billing data (10 years), tax reporting

consent.label: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)):
consent.text: Newsletter and marketing communications (opt-in only, unsubscribe anytime)

cookiesAnalytics.label: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)):
cookiesAnalytics.text: Audience measurement cookies/trackers (Google Analytics via Google Tag Manager), only after your choice

recipients.title: Data recipients
recipients.body: Your personal data may be accessed by:

internal.label: Sublynk internal team:
internal.text: Customer support and technical administration (limited to what is strictly necessary)

processors.label: Technical processors:
processors.text: Hosting, payments, email delivery (see dedicated section below)

legal.label: Legal authorities:
legal.text: Only upon a lawful request (court order, legal requisition)

recipients.noSale: We never sell your personal data to third parties.

rights.title: Your rights under GDPR
rights.body: As a data subject, you have full rights under GDPR. Here is how to exercise them:

access.title: Right of access (Art. 15)
access.body: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you. Contact us at contact@sublynk.fr for a complete access request.

rectification.title: Right to rectification (Art. 16)
rectification.body: Correct inaccurate data directly in your dashboard (profile, organization), or contact us to update information you cannot edit yourself.

erasure.title: Right to erasure (Art. 17)
erasure.body: Request deletion of your account and associated data by contacting contact@sublynk.fr. We will delete or anonymize data within 30 days, except where legal retention is required (billing data: 10 years) or where necessary to handle disputes/fraud.

portability.title: Right to data portability (Art. 20)
portability.body: Request an export of your data in a structured format (JSON) by contacting us. This includes your account information, products, customers, and transaction history.

object.title: Right to object (Art. 21)
object.body: Object to processing based on legitimate interest. Contact us at contact@sublynk.fr and we will review your request within 30 days.

restriction.title: Right to restriction (Art. 18)
restriction.body: Request restricted processing while we verify data accuracy or assess an objection. Contact us at contact@sublynk.fr.

payment.data: Transactions, amounts, invoices (handled via Stripe; payment email collected by Stripe)

access.data: Telegram username (required), Telegram IDs (if available), invitation links; email only if provided

backups.data: Database and file copies required for restoration

analytics.data: Navigation data and events (e.g., CTA clicks), without directly identifying data

subProcessors.title: Processors
subProcessors.body: We use the following processors to provide our service. Each has appropriate safeguards for data transfers:

stripe.name: Stripe
stripe.safeguards: SCC (where applicable) + security measures (encryption, minimization); DPF where applicable depending on certification

flyio.name: Fly.io
flyio.safeguards: Data hosted in the EU (depending on region configuration)

neon.name: Neon (PostgreSQL)
neon.safeguards: Data hosted in the EU, encryption at rest (depending on provider configuration)

telegram.name: Telegram
telegram.purpose: Bot API to manage channel access
telegram.safeguards: Minimal data (IDs only); we do not store message content

transfers.title: International transfers
transfers.body: Some of our processors may be based in or operate outside the EU/EEA (e.g., Stripe, Vercel). For these transfers, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as:

measures.label: Supplementary measures:
measures.text: Encryption in transit (TLS 1.3), data minimization, pseudonymization where possible

security.title: Security measures
security.body: We implement technical and organizational measures to protect your data:

list.item1: Encryption in transit (TLS 1.3) for all communications
list.item2: Encryption at rest when available with our providers (e.g., database)
list.item3: Passwords hashed with bcrypt (never stored in plain text)
list.item4: Authentication tokens with expiration and renewal mechanisms

breach.title: Personal data breach notification
breach.body: In case of a personal data breach likely to result in a risk to your rights and freedoms, we will notify the CNIL within 72 hours and inform you without undue delay in accordance with Articles 33 and 34 of GDPR.

contact.title: Exercise your rights / Contact us
contact.body: For any request relating to your personal data or to exercise your GDPR rights:

free.label: Cost:

hero.title: Simple, transparent pricing
hero.subtitle: One plan. No hidden fees. No commission on your sales.

example.label: Example:
example.text: If you make €5,000/month, competitors charge €150-750 in commission.
example.highlight: With us, you pay €39. You save €111-711 every month.

item1.question: Is there really 0% commission?
item1.answer: Yes. We charge a flat monthly fee only. You keep 100% of your revenue. Stripe processing fees (typically 1.4% + €0.25 for EU cards) are separate and go directly to Stripe, not us.

item2.question: What happens after the free trial?
item2.answer: Your account continues to work. We'll send you a reminder before the trial ends. If you don't upgrade, your payment links will pause until you subscribe.

item3.question: Can I cancel anytime?
item3.answer: Absolutely. No contracts, no commitments. Cancel from your dashboard with one click. Your existing members keep their access until their subscriptions expire.

item4.question: Do I need a Stripe account?
item4.answer: Yes. We use Stripe Connect so payments go directly to your Stripe account. If you don't have one, you can create it during onboarding - it takes about 5 minutes.

item5.question: Which platforms are supported?
item5.answer: Currently Telegram (including Telegram Stars), with Discord and WhatsApp coming soon. You can manage all platforms from a single dashboard.

item6.question: Is my data safe?
item6.answer: We're EU-based and fully GDPR-compliant. Your data is stored in European data centers. You can export or delete your data anytime from your dashboard.

hero.title: Empowering content creators to monetize their communities
hero.body: TelegramPlugin was born from a simple observation: creators deserve better tools. While dominant platforms set the rules, creators face real challenges — from payment restrictions to GDPR compliance.

paragraphs.p1: We started as creators ourselves, running Telegram communities and struggling with the same problems you face: clunky payment solutions, high commissions eating into our revenue, and tools that weren't designed with data protection regulations in mind.
paragraphs.p2: In 2025, we decided to build the platform we wished existed. One that puts creators first, respects privacy, and doesn't take a cut of your hard-earned revenue.
paragraphs.p3: Today, TelegramPlugin helps creators monetize their Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp communities — without the headaches.

botSetup.title: How to add the bot to your channel
botSetup.subtitle: The @SublynkBot automatically manages access to your channel. Here's how to set it up:

important.label: Important:
important.text: Without these permissions, the bot won't be able to generate invite links for your new subscribers.

q1.question: How do I get my Telegram channel ID?
q1.answer: Forward a message from your channel to @userinfobot. It will reply with the channel ID (starts with -100). You can also use @getidsbot by temporarily adding it to your channel.

q2.question: Does the bot need to stay as administrator?
q2.answer: Yes, the bot must remain an administrator to generate invite links for each new subscriber and revoke access when needed.

q3.question: What happens when a subscriber pays?
q3.answer: The payment is processed by Stripe, then our bot automatically generates a unique invite link and sends it to the subscriber. Access is instant.

q4.question: What happens if a subscription is canceled?
q4.answer: At the end of the paid period, the bot automatically revokes the subscriber's access to the channel. You don't need to do anything manually.

q5.question: Can I have multiple channels?
q5.answer: Yes! You can connect as many channels as you want and associate them with different products or offers.

q6.question: Are payments secure?
q6.answer: Absolutely. All payments are processed by Stripe, the world leader in online payments. We never store your banking data.
